<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.0691 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within typical high‑resolution error and is consistent with the observed ~12 % M+1 isotopic intensity (≈12 carbons) is C₉H₁₀N₂O₄. This formula yields a calculated monoisotopic mass of 210.0641 Da (≈5 mDa difference, ~24 ppm), which is the closest reasonable match among plausible candidates. Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is C₉H₁₀N₂O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10N2O4</final_answer>
